about.title: About Promos 2025
paragraphs: Promos 2025 gathers the 7 promo cards from 7 products released in 2025: WCS 2025 Limited Pack, The Lost Art Promotion 2025 F, The Lost Art Promotion 2025 A, The Lost Art Promotion 2025 B, The Lost Art Promotion 2025 C, The Lost Art Promotion 2025 D and The Lost Art Promotion 2025 E.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 7 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 8, adding the 1 other rarity).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
